coverage_notes:
[territories-utilities-gov] Checked against the territory rows of rosters/electric_utilities.csv (EIA-861: PREPA 1,511,847 customers; Guam Power Authority 53,559; VI WAPA 54,457; CNMI CUC 17,555; ASPA 12,684 - all five have detailed entries) and rosters/water_systems_large.csv (EPA SDWIS: every large PR system belongs to PRASA/AAA, Guam systems to GWA; CUC and ASPA provide water in CNMI/AS; WAPA provides potable water in the USVI), so every territory resident's electric and water biller is covered. Electric in PR: LUMA Energy bills all PREPA/AEE customers; Genera PR (New Fortress) only operates PREPA's legacy power plants and does not bill customers, so it has no entry. Behind-the-meter solar lessors in PR/GU/VI on EIA (Sunnova ~54k PR customers, Sunrun ~28k PR) bill separately for solar leases/PPAs but are out of scope here. Government: PR property tax (CRIM), PR income tax (Hacienda/SURI), PR marbete/driver services (CESCO/DTOP), Guam DRT income tax and real property tax (PayGuam), Guam vehicle registration renewal (MyGuamTax; the reviewer corrected an earlier pointer to myid.guam.gov, which is the driver's-license/ID portal), USVI BIR income tax, USVI Tax Collector property tax, USVI BMV, CNMI Division of Revenue and Taxation, American Samoa Tax Office. Propane: Tropigas and Empire Gas (PR) are detailed here and also appear as roster entries in propane-heating-oil.json. Not duplicated here because they exist elsewhere: AutoExpreso (PR tolls, dmv-tolls-municipal.json), Liberty Puerto Rico and Claro Puerto Rico (cable/internet/landline/wireless files), Triple-S and MCS (medicare-health-insurance.json); also already elsewhere: Viya and GTA/Teleguam, IT&E (CNMI), Bluesky (AS), Banco Popular/FirstBank PR, PR public housing and ASUME. Trash: Puerto Rico municipalities generally fund residential trash collection from municipal revenue (CRIM/IVU) and do not send separate household trash bills; USVI and CNMI likewise have no household trash bill found; ASPA bills solid waste on its combined utility bill; Guam Solid Waste Authority does bill about 20,000 curbside households monthly; the reviewer found its official site (gswa.guam.gov) and upgraded it to detailed. Limits this session: web search quota was exhausted partway through, so later research relied on direct fetches of official sites; several official pages render with JavaScript or refused automated fetch (GPA financial-assistance page 403, ADSEF site refused connection, guamtax.com contact page blank). Reviewer pass 2026-09-30: every URL in the file was status-checked with curl (all resolve; lumapr.com returns 403 and guamwaterworks.org returns 429 to curl, so those pages were re-read with a fetch tool). Page content was re-read for 25+ entries' links. Changes: GSWA upgraded from roster to detailed. Guam MVD entry corrected to the MyGuamTax renewal and verified. Guam DRT income-tax and RPT entries got phones, mailing address, the MyGuamTax 'How to pay your 1040' page and the Senior Citizen & Disability real property tax credit. CESCO URLs updated for the web.cescodigital.pr.gov redirect, and the marbete pay_bill now points to Hacienda's colecturía directory, which lists marbete renewal. AAA got its separate payment and correspondence PO boxes, CUC got a payment-arrangements link, and ASPA notes now cover the CashPower prepaid option. CNMI and American Samoa levy essentially no residential real property tax bill, so no property-tax entries exist for them. Web search was unavailable to the reviewer (quota exhausted), so new billers could be found only by probing official domains.

[trash-independent-haulers-gapfill] Built 2026-10-02 (last_checked 2026-09-30 per run instructions) as a gap-fill for independent/regional residential haulers. Every name was checked against trash-recycling.json, trash-municipal-gapfill.json, trash-regional-municipal-gapfill.json and the other category files before adding. ROSTERS USED (completeness checked against): Vermont DEC permitted solid-waste transporter registry (all 532 permits read; ~55 residential-type VT/NH haulers kept, junk-removal, septic, excavation, scrap and district/town permits excluded); Cobb County GA 2026 permitted-hauler list (all 18 private haulers covered); Forsyth County GA hauler list (all residential haulers covered); Wake County NC FY2027 licensed-hauler list (all ~120 licensees read; residential curbside subscription haulers kept, junk/dumpster/valet-only firms excluded); Lincoln County NC, Anderson County SC (business-named haulers only; sole proprietors listed only by a personal name were left out), Jefferson County MO, St. Charles County MO, City of Independence MO and York County PA hauler lists (all covered). GFL's ~120 acquired-company welcome pages were all read; US residential haulers became legacy-name pointers (35) so seniors who still know the old company name can find the current biller and the autopay re-enrollment instructions. DETAILED (80): 38 hand-researched independents (GA 6, NC 8, PA 3, NJ 3, NH/VT 2, OH 1, MO 4, IA/MN 1, TX 1, OR 3, CO 1, NY 1, ME 1, WI 1, CA 2), 7 separately branded Waste Connections local sites (Hoodview, Canby and Cascade in OR; Vail Honeywagon CO; Bay Disposal VA; Scott Waste KY; Pro-Star TX) and 35 GFL legacy-name pointers. Payment processors were recorded from pay links (Navusoft, Hauler Hero, TrashBilling.com/Trash Flow, Soft-Pak WebPak, AMCS eTower/portal, TruxWeb, online-billpay.com, onlineportal.us.com, WAM, Stripe, BillerPayments, Converge, Waste Connections MyAccount, GFL MyAccount). verified=true means every URL in the entry returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-02 (curl) and the page content was read. Senior discounts found: Ted's Trash (Independence MO, 65+ rate), Suburban Carting (Westchester/Putnam NY), Cascade Disposal (Bend income-based discount). Most private haulers publish no senior or low-income program, and the Waste Connections brand FAQs explicitly say there is no senior discount. KNOWN GAPS: the WebSearch quota for this session was already used up, so discovery relied on state/county registries, sitemaps and domain checks. Pennsylvania DEP's authorized waste-transporter data, New Jersey's A-901 licensee list (nj.gov is bot-protected), Georgia EPD and New Hampshire DES (403) could not be downloaded, and Ohio, Iowa and Oklahoma have no statewide hauler registry, so OH (1 detailed + 1 legacy pointer), IA (1), OK (3 GFL legacy pointers) and PA/NJ remain thin. Most of PA, NJ and OH is served through municipal contracts (already covered as municipal entries elsewhere) or by WM/Republic/WC/GFL/Casella/Rumpke/Kimble/Penn Waste/Mascaro. Several small haulers have no website; they are roster entries with the phone from the official list. Interstate Waste Services, Tri-County Industries (PA) and Seegreen (GA) block automated fetches (403) and are roster-only. SECOND STEP (trash-recycling.json): all 38 WA certificated haulers that had no website were researched from their WUTC tariff title pages; 26 now have a website (most with pay pages, phones, processors and parent company, e.g. 11 are Waste Connections subsidiaries and Sound Disposal is Republic), 12 have no website (phones from the tariffs recorded) and every one now links its current WUTC tariff. Detailed-entry coverage in trash-recycling.json was raised: autopay_cancel 20 to 28 of 61, statements_history 22 to 30 of 61, payment_assistance 16 to 19 of 61 (municipal entries now point to the utility that actually bills the trash fee, plus South Tahoe Refuse's low-income senior rate and Dick's Sanitation's senior discount). The remaining gaps there are private haulers whose public sites do not describe stopping autopay, statement history or any assistance. SECOND PASS (2026-10-02, WebSearch available): 109 entries added to cover the thin states, with every name and domain checked against all category files first. New coverage by state: OH 7 (Ohio Valley Waste Systems, Holhart, Buckey, Ohio Valley Waste Service, ARS, Heartland, Skaggs), PA 14 (Symons, Prestige, Independent Waste NEPA, B Gone, J&S, Berger, Randy's, Econ, Hollenbaugh's, East Penn, plus legacy pointers Park's to Patriot and White Tail to Casella), NJ 5 (Pinto Brothers with a senior rate, Direct Waste, JC Sanitation, and pointers Grand Sanitation and Seaside to Interstate Waste Services), IA 3 (ABC Disposal, O.C. Sanitation, Garbage Guys), OK 1 (Oklahoma Waste Services), MO 5 (Moore's, Henson, Ozark Refuse, Queen City, Kansas City Disposal), NC 9 (Carolina Trash & Septic, American Disposal Service, It's Gross, Cumberland Garbage, and 5 phone-only haulers from Harnett County's official list), SC 4 (Spartan, Ever Green, Palmetto, Rural Garbage Service), NH/ME 4 (Buckley, Trashbusters with a 65+ senior tier, MD's, The Can Man), plus IN 7, KY 4, TN 6, MN 4, IL 2, TX 9, KS 3, NE 2, AR 4, LA 1, AL 1, FL 1, AZ 1, WV/VA/MD 11, MI 1, WI 1 and GA 1. The existing Trash Taxi of GA entry gained billing, autopay, paperless and FAQ details from its second domain. Senior discounts found in this pass: B Gone Waste (PA), Pinto Brothers (NJ senior rate), Trashbusters (NH 65+ tier), ICT Trash (KS, $3/quarter off) and Crossroads Country Trash (TX). Three of the new 'independents' are Waste Connections MyAccount tenants and are flagged as such: One Waste Solutions (TN), Mid State Waste (KY) and Schaap Sanitation (MN). verified=false is used where the site blocked automated fetches (Cloudflare/202 challenge pages). STILL MISSING: Pennsylvania DEP's transporter list and NJ's A-901 list still could not be downloaded, so PA/NJ coverage is search-based rather than registry-complete. OH, IA and OK have no statewide registry and are still thin outside metro areas. The WebSearch budget (200) ran out before New York, New England (ME/MA/CT/RI), Florida and the Mountain/West states could be searched again; those regions rely on the earlier passes and the sibling files. Junk-removal-only and dumpster-only firms were excluded (e.g. AJ's Hauling, Rolling Waste, TrashCab multifamily valet). State tally for the whole file now: AL 2, AR 5, AZ 1, CA 2, CO 3, CT 3, FL 1, GA 21, IA 4, IL 6, IN 11, KS 4, KY 5, LA 2, MA 2, MD 9, ME 3, MI 14, MN 5, MO 13, MS 2, NC 28, NE 2, NH 14, NJ 10, NY 5, OH 9, OK 4, OR 6, PA 19, SC 24, TN 6, TX 11, VA 6, VT 59, WI 8, WV 6. REVIEWER PASS (2026-10-02): A second pass re-checked the whole file. Every one of the 438 URLs was fetched with curl; 21 returned 403 or 202 bot-check pages and 2 domains no longer resolve. Page text from all detailed entries' pages, plus about 100 more FAQ, billing and pricing pages linked from their sites, was searched for autopay-cancel, statement-history and senior wording. JavaScript-only pages (Spartan Waste, 121 Disposal, Carolina Trash, Rural Trash Service, Duffy's, Interstate Waste Services) were re-read with WebFetch. Fixes: the Mid-Nebraska pay URL was updated after a redirect. Cumberland Garbage (NC) and Skaggs Disposal (OH) websites were set to null because their domains no longer resolve (now verified=false). Autopay links on Spartan Waste and 121 Disposal (plus 121's paperless link) were cleared because the pages do not mention them. Upgrades: Interstate Waste Services was upgraded to detailed after its FAQ was read: MyIWS portal, Billtrust statements, 1-866-DIAL-IWS option 1 pay-by-phone, and the Chicago lockbox. The Grand Sanitation, Seaside and Oak Ridge pointers now give the MyIWS login and phone. Links filled: autopay_cancel was added for County Waste Service, Clean Away, Mid State Waste and One Waste Solutions. Autopay setup pages were added for Custom Disposal, Flood Brothers, Independent Waste, Rural Waste Management and Suburban Carting. view_bill and statements_history now point to TrashBilling.com's View Account for 24 TrashBilling-billed haulers that had none (this rests on the platform's View Account History feature, as described by Symons Sanitation). view_bill was filled for 8 more and statements_history for 2 more from their pay pages. Senior and discount info: Illini Recycling's Mahomet senior rate, Lambert's Community Heroes discount and Collectors Trash's low-volume rate were added. New entries: Stateline Disposal (IL/WI) and Sweitzer Waste (CT, found because hometownwaste.com redirects there). bigorefuse.com redirects to wm.com, but the brand's state could not be confirmed, so it was not added. American Waste Control (Tulsa) and Stevens Disposal (MI/OH) were found but are already in trash-municipal-gapfill.json, so they were not duplicated. A domain cross-check against every other category file found no duplicates. Limits of this pass: the WebSearch quota was exhausted and search engines block automated queries, so no new registry-scale discovery was possible. OH, PA, NJ, IA and OK remain thin relative to their real independent-hauler populations. Detailed-entry counts after review (of 161): pay_bill 160, view_bill 107, autopay_setup 103, autopay_cancel 60, statements_history 112, payment_assistance 7, phone 121, processor 139, senior_programs 18. 35 of the detailed entries are GFL legacy-name pointers that share GFL MyAccount links.

Consolidated city-counties (Miami-Dade, Duval, Jefferson KY, Davidson, Denver) are pointer entries. Additional senior-heavy and suburban counties outside the top 100 were added: Hernando, Pasco, Charlotte, Martin, Sumter (The Villages), Volusia FL; Brunswick, Onslow, Iredell, Gaston, Buncombe NC; Chesterfield, Hanover VA; Anne Arundel, Harford MD; Plymouth and Falmouth MA (transfer-station permit / curbside). REGIONAL HAULERS: checked against every hauler name in trash-recycling.json and trash-regional-municipal-gapfill.json before adding (Meridian, Kimble, J.P. Mascaro, Texas Disposal Systems, LRS/Lakeshore, Alpine, Sunshine Disposal (WA), Hometown Sanitation (WA), Waste Industries (GFL) were already present and not duplicated). Added ~50 haulers/brands: Amwaste (AL/GA/LA), Granger (MI), Best Way Disposal (MI/IN/KY/OH), Stevens Disposal (MI), Modern Disposal and Syracuse Haulers (NY), American Waste Control (OK), CWD, Best Trash, Tiger Sanitation, Red River Waste Management (TX), Red River Waste Solutions (TN), Harter's (WI/MN), Vogel (PA, senior 10% discount), Pelican Waste (LA/MS), four unrelated 'Patriot' companies (Mid-Atlantic, LA, AZ, MD), Hometown-named companies (WI, Memphis, central PA now Patriot, central IL), Mountain High, Apex, WSI, Timberline (CO), Red Oak (GA), Ace Solid Waste, LePage, Curbside Waste (MN), Robinson (UT), USA Waste & Recycling/Paine's (New England), Troiano (ME), E.L. Harvey (MA), Bates Trucking (MD/DC/VA), Lake Area Disposal and Hometown Waste Solutions (IL), California franchise haulers E.J. Harrison, Mid Valley, Gilton, Bertolotti, Cal Waste, Mt. Diablo Resource Recovery, Upper Valley Disposal, Napa Recycling (CARE-linked RateShare discount), plus legacy-name pointers (Winters Bros and Ray's Trash now WM; Arrow Disposal now Meridian). SEPTIC: Wind River Environmental added (Roto-Rooter and Septic Blue already in trash-recycling.json). Rooter-Man was checked and does not advertise septic pumping. VERIFICATION: every URL was fetched by curl on 2026-09-30 (HTTP 200 plus trash/billing keywords) or read with WebFetch; unreachable URLs (HTTP 0/404/410) were removed. verified=true means all listed URLs passed. Many city sites (Tempe, Tucson, Waco, Victorville, Sunnyvale, Naperville, Joliet, Columbia SC, Pomona, Lakewood CO, Miramar, Gainesville, KCK, Syracuse) return 403 to automated clients, so those entries remain roster/unverified with billing method from general knowledge (flagged in notes). Phone numbers from memory were dropped unless seen on a fetched page. REVIEWER PASS 2026-09-30: (1) Cross-file duplicates: 27 city entries duplicated cities already in trash-regional-municipal-gapfill.json (the researcher had only checked that file for hauler names). They were removed here: Honolulu, St. Petersburg, Dallas, Long Beach, Arlington TX, Spokane, Corpus Christi, Santa Ana, Riverside, Chandler, Scottsdale, Glendale AZ, Frisco, Thornton, Modesto, Grand Prairie, Amarillo, Mesquite, Phoenix, Garland, Denton, Seattle, Austin, Sacramento, Tulsa, Grand Rapids, plus the Henderson/North Las Vegas pointer, which duplicated Republic Services of Southern Nevada. Those cities are covered in trash-regional-municipal-gapfill.json. Eight overlaps were kept here because this entry has as many or more confirmed links: Albuquerque, Little Rock, Jackson MS, Lubbock, Huntington Beach, Tucson, Mesa, Republic Services of Southern Nevada. Each is flagged 'DUPLICATE ACROSS FILES' in notes so they can be merged. (2) Links filled from sibling entries: about 42 cities whose trash is billed on a water, electric or combined utility bill now carry that utility's bill, pay, autopay, history and assistance links, billing phone and processor. These came from verified entries in water-*.json, electric-*.json and sewer-stormwater-separate-billers.json and were re-fetched. About 27 property-tax-billed cities and counties now link to their county tax collector's pages from property-tax.json, and a note explains that these pages are for paying the whole tax bill. About 22 franchise-hauler city entries (Republic, WM, Recology, Burrtec, Waste Connections, Amwaste) now use the hauler's company-wide billing help pages. (3) About 30 pages were read directly with WebFetch or curl to confirm autopay-cancel, pay-by-phone and mailing addresses: OKC, Mesa, Tucson, Tallahassee, Tacoma, Minneapolis, Lubbock, Denton, Visalia, Buffalo, Springfield MA, Baton Rouge, Augusta, American Waste Control, Best Trash, Tiger, Best Way, Ace, Home Town Disposal, USA Waste, Robinson, Wind River and others. Autopay_cancel was also filled where the autopay or pay page text explicitly describes stopping automatic payments. (4) Detailed entries with no bill, pay or autopay link at all were moved to roster (35 of them). Most are tax-funded cities with no trash bill (Boston, Columbus, Baltimore, KCMO, Omaha, Cincinnati, Pittsburgh and others), pay-as-you-throw bag programs, or haulers with no public pay page. (5) Added A.J. Blosenski (PA, Waste Connections MyAccount), WIN Waste Innovations residential (Northeast and OH; the legacy Waste Away Systems domain now redirects to WIN) and Waste-Away Group/Borden (IN/MI, roster). (6) Many city .gov pages return HTTP 403 to automated fetches (Akamai or Cloudflare). Those URLs were kept when a sibling category had verified them, but the entry's verified flag was not raised. After review: 322 entries, 166 detailed, 187 verified. Among detailed entries, 68 have autopay_cancel, 90 have statements_history and 116 have payment_processor. SECOND REVIEW CHECK 2026-09-30 (resumed session): re-ran a link-status sweep over the 76 URLs on the 27 detailed-but-unverified entries; 22 return 200 and 54 return HTTP 403 to both curl and WebFetch (Raleigh, Greensboro, Cary, Fort Lauderdale, Tempe, Gilbert, Peoria AZ, Oxnard, Olathe, Irving, Aurora IL, Milwaukee, Detroit, Glendale CA, Salem OR, Santa Clara County DTAC, Fulton County tax, Miami-Dade tax collector, Vogel Disposal, some Paymentus portals). These are bot-blocking responses, not dead links, so the URLs were kept and those entries stay verified=false. No duplicate names remain in the file.

[trash-recycling] Coverage (2026-09-29): all national publicly traded haulers (WM incl. legacy Advanced Disposal, Republic incl. Allied/Rabanco, Waste Connections and several district brands, GFL incl. legacy WCA Waste and Waste Industries, Casella) plus the major regional independents named in scope (Rumpke, Waste Pro, Coastal, Priority Waste, Meridian, Frontier, LRS, Texas Disposal Systems, Recology, CR&R, Burrtec, Athens, EDCO, GreenWaste, MarBorg, Kimble, J.P. Mascaro, Penn Waste, Homewood, Rogue, ACE, Aspen, Walters, Pellitteri, Johns Disposal, Suburban Disposal, All American Waste, Texas Pride, etc.). Washington is complete for WUTC-regulated haulers (roster tier from the WUTC tariff list). Municipal: LA (LADWP bill), San Antonio (CPS bill), Denver (Denver Utilities Online), St. Paul (assessment billing), St. Louis (water-refuse bill), Tampa, Memphis (MLGW), El Paso, New Orleans (S&WB), Fresno, Anchorage SWS, Miami-Dade, Jacksonville and Lee County (property-tax assessment), Portland (franchise hauler lookup). Other cities where trash rides on a combined city utility bill (Phoenix, Austin, Seattle, OKC, Minneapolis, Chicago, Milwaukee, etc.) are covered in the water-*/electric-* category files. Septic: Roto-Rooter and Septic Blue (septic is usually billed per service, not recurring). Completeness was checked against the WUTC roster, Wikipedia's U.S. waste company category and the Waste Connections sitemap. The WebSearch budget was used up in this session, so the Waste Today Top-100 list (bot-protected) was NOT used as a checklist; several JS-only or bot-blocked sites (LRS, CR&R, Texas Disposal Systems, San Jose, Charlotte, Raleigh, Fort Worth, Atlanta, Kansas City, Columbus, Omaha, Louisville) could not be read and are roster-tier or missing. REVIEWER PASS (2026-09-29): every URL in the file (206) was status-checked with curl, and about 35 detailed entries were re-fetched and read (WM, Republic, Waste Connections, GFL, Casella, Rumpke, Waste Pro, Coastal, Priority, Recology, EDCO, Athens, Frontier, Burrtec, Rogue, Kimble, Mascaro, Penn Waste, MarBorg, Valley Vista, Aspen, Pride, Sunshine, GreenWaste, Groot, Marin Sanitary, Suburban, Johns, Walters, St. Paul, Fresno, Denver, Anchorage, Tampa, St. Louis and Miami-Dade). Fixes: redirected URLs updated (GreenWaste, Fresno, St. Paul, Denver rebate and portal, New Orleans, WM view-bill article, St. Louis PayIt login). Aspen phone numbers corrected to the residential lines. Mail addresses, fees and autopay details added. Senior and assistance programs filled for EDCO (10% for 65+ in Rancho Palos Verdes), Burrtec (fee waiver), Fresno, Recology (flagged as King County-specific) and Casella (hardship plans). Merged or removed: the WCA Waste and Waste Industries entries were folded into GFL, and the WUTC 'Sunshine Disposal, Inc.' roster duplicate was folded into the detailed Sunshine entry. WA subsidiaries of Republic, WM and Waste Connections are now linked to their parents. Added: Dick's Sanitation (MN, Waste Connections), Ridwell (subscription recycling) and the City of San Diego Solid Waste Management Fee (new, on the county property-tax bill, with an assistance program). Still weak: LRS, CR&R and Texas Disposal Systems render client-side or block bots and remain roster-tier. Western Disposal (Boulder) and Interstate Waste Services returned 403, and Alpine Waste (Denver) did not resolve; none of the three was added. Wind River Environmental (septic) now has a parked domain, and besttrash.com is parked, so Best Trash's current site is unknown. The web-search quota was exhausted, so no new national top-100 hauler list was consulted. No WM national phone number is published. Charlotte and San Antonio city pages return 403 to automated fetches. THIRD PASS (2026-10-02): Upper Okanogan Valley Disposal (Pellegrini, WUTC G000021) website and pay portal found; the other 9 WA certificate holders without a website were re-checked by probing likely domains, and none led to a matching company site. Gary's Garbage, Naslund, Nooksack Valley, San Juan Sanitation, Sunrise, West Waste, Community Waste & Recycling, Disposal Services Inc. and Sphuler remain phone/tariff-only. Statement-history links were added from portal pages (Soft-Pak Web-Pak, Navusoft, onlineportal.us.com) for Meridian, Ware, South Tahoe, Pellitteri, ACE, Frontier and Local Waste, and Pride's reduced-rate program was added. National haulers (Republic, Waste Connections, GFL, Rumpke, Waste Pro) publish no hardship or senior program on their FAQ/billing pages (re-checked 2026-10-02). [trash-regional-municipal-gapfill] Built 2026-09-29/30 as a gap-fill to trash-recycling.json (deduped by name). Every entry is bill_type trash. COMPLETENESS SOURCES: (1) Waste Connections sitemap - every district/brand landing page (~95) fetched and its local phone extracted; (2) Republic Services sitemap - 14.6k location pages grouped into one roster entry per state (48 states + DC) listing served towns, plus ~40 municipal-franchise pages that expose local phones and billing contacts; (3) WM merged sitemap - residential 'trash-pickup' location pages grouped into one roster entry per state; (4) cross-reference of municipal utility entries in the water-*/electric-*/gas-* category files whose service description says trash/solid waste/sanitation/refuse is on the bill (40 trash entries created, links reused and re-checked by HTTP; see each entry's notes); (5) hand research of city solid-waste billing pages for the 14 states + DC that had no coverage. Previously uncovered states now have entries: AR (Little Rock, WC Heber Springs/Ash Flat, Republic/WM rosters), HI (Maui County separate semiannual refuse bill; Honolulu tax-funded), ID (Boise, Nampa, Pocatello, Coeur d'Alene, Idaho Falls, Republic Treasure Valley, WC Lakeshore Disposal), KS (WC Wichita, Stutzman Refuse, Pittsburg, Town & Country Disposal), MT (Billings, Great Falls, Republic Montana), NE (WC Southeast Nebraska/Lincoln, Fremont, Schaben/North Platte, Scottsbluff, Ogallala; Papillion Sanitation noted as defunct domain), NV (Republic Southern Nevada, WM Reno/Sparks/Washoe), NM (Albuquerque on ABCWUA bill with low-income credit, Santa Fe, Las Cruces), ND (Fargo, Minot), OK (Tulsa, Norman low-income trash rate, Edmond, WC OKC/Lawton/Chickasha/Duncan/Bartlesville/B&B Sanitation), RI (Pawtucket and East Providence tax-funded, Republic/WM rosters, Mega Disposal nearby), SD (Mitchell, Aberdeen, Watertown), WY (Casper, Laramie, WC Casper, Republic Wyoming), DC (DPW: no recurring bill, senior container discount, hardship service). WHERE BILLED: city utility bill (most western/southern cities), water authority bill (Albuquerque, Baton Rouge, Dallas, Tucson), property tax (Grand Rapids recycling, San Diego/Jacksonville etc. in trash-recycling.json), separate county bill (Maui), prepaid per-tip account (Grand Rapids), tax-funded with no bill (DC, Honolulu, most RI/NJ/MA/NY cities). LIMITS: the WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted before this task started, so discovery relied on sitemaps, official city homepages and known domains. Many large-city sites (Charlotte, Raleigh, Atlanta, Detroit, Louisville, Kansas City MO, Omaha, Lincoln, Sioux Falls, Rapid City, Cheyenne, Olathe, Lawrence, Wilmington DE, Kauai, Hawaii County, Meridian ID, Las Cruces) returned bot-protection 403s to automated fetches and are missing or roster-only. Generated Waste Connections/Republic entries reuse national how-to pages (bill-pay hub, auto-pay, online-account) because local pages do not repeat them; this is noted in each entry. Senior discounts are rare among private haulers; municipal low-income/senior programs were captured where published (Albuquerque, Norman, Santa Fe, DC, St. Petersburg, Nampa).
